name: skillcache
description: Standalone SkillCache compiler, sandbox gate verifier (Gate 1/2/3), warm capsule executor, and stdio MCP server for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Verified warm skill compilation, sandboxed Gate 1/2/3 checks, and capsule lifecycle
interface.longDescription: Compiles observed agent skill traces into sealed hybrid or textual capsules, validates static dataflow and secrets via Gate 1, executes isolated --unshare-net / sandbox-exec checks via Gate 2 & Gate 3 replay, manages capsule invalidation/requalification/retirement in private SQLite state, and exposes multicall skillcache-run / skillcache-tool execution plus a 2025-06-18 stdio MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Check SkillCache readiness and active capsules for this repository.
Run Gate 1 validation on a capsule package directory.
Compile or requalify a SkillCache capsule for this repository.
